observations: The page number «69» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 continues chapter 23 from p. 68 (JP2 0100, L33-L37).

L28-L30: the example of the sixth row of the sine table, set as a small table centred in the page: four groups, each headed «Sig.» (signs) and «Gr.» (degrees), divided and closed by vertical rules, which are not transcribed; «das heisst :» at the right of the second row; the third row, the angles in degrees, stands below the groups, each value centred in its group. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; in L30 each value spans its group, the empty cells after it are not printed. Checked: 0 signs 6° = 6°, 5 signs 24° = 174°, 6 signs 6° = 186°, 11 signs 24° = 354°, the four angles whose sine is ± sin 6°.

L33-L34. Checked: 60 sin 6° = 6.27171 = 6p 16′ 18.1″; 6 + 16/60 + 18/3600 = 6.271667, which Suter truncates to 6,27166; 6.271667 : 60 = 0.104528, «0,10453», and sin 6° = 0.1045285, «0,104528». L33: the two fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}; «6p», the p raised and italic.

L04-L05: «ums Jahr 1126», the date of the translation given in O (p. 37, JP2 0069, L10-L21). L13-L15 and L21: «elmankūs», «mankūs» without dots, «manḳūṣ» with the dots under ḳ and ṣ, «maʿkūs» with the ʿayn raised; L32 «daḳā’iḳ» with the dots and the apostrophe of the hamza; L33 «thāniya»; L10 «Djābir b. Aflaḥ», spaced, with the dot under the ḥ.

L09: the arch of the n of «nicht» is covered by a grey blot, its two stems visible; L14: after «mit» a thin vertical stroke, lighter than the print, of spacing material, as on p. 66 (JP2 0098, L26); not transcribed. L23: the final s of «sinus» is printed light.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Athelhard», «Athelhards», «Robert von Chester», «Gerhard von Cremona», «Djābir b. Aflaḥ», «Batt.», «Björnbo»; italics: the Arabic and Latin words, «Sinus versus» (L13; upright in L23), «Semitae numerorum», «partes», «partitiones», «dakaicae», «theniae», «eltheniae».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-14 px measured; «Zahlenzeile :» 10 px).
